issues.display_title: Issue #49: feat(ingest): video ingest pipeline resumability and frame reconciliation
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Summary

Added support for resumable video extraction to prevent restarting ingest from 0% upon user cancellation, application restart, or unexpected interruption.

Key Changes

  • FFmpeg Seek & Numbering: Added -ss\ fast seek and -start_number\ parameters in \crates/sb-core/src/media/ffmpeg.rs.
  • Frame Validation & Reconciliation: Implemented \extract_frames_resumable\ and \scan_and_reconcile_frames\ in \crates/sb-core/src/media/extract.rs\ to detect valid JPEG prefix and clean truncated/corrupt tails.
  • Manifest Ingest State: Added \IngestState\ schema (\status, \stage, \sourceFingerprint, \extractedFrames) to \ProjectManifest\ in \crates/sb-core/src/project/schema.rs.
  • Cancellation Checkpoint: Ensured graceful status persistence and cancellation events across ingest stages.

✅ Implementation & Verification Summary

Status: Completed & Ready for Review

Summary of Work Done:

  1. Fast-Seeking & Sequential Output:
    • Updated FFmpeg extraction arguments in \crates/sb-core/src/media/ffmpeg.rs\ to support -ss \ before input for fast keyframe seeking and -start_number \ for output naming.
  2. Resumable Frame Extraction & Reconcile:
    • Implemented \extract_frames_resumable\ and \scan_and_reconcile_frames\ in \crates/sb-core/src/media/extract.rs.
    • The pipeline checks sequential \ rame%04d.jpg\ files, validates JPEG integrity, and cleans any corrupt trailing frames left from unexpected interrupts.
  3. Manifest State Tracking:
    • Extended \ProjectManifest\ schema in \crates/sb-core/src/project/schema.rs\ with \IngestState, recording stages (\Probing, \Frames, \Thumbnail, \Gps, \Finalizing), status, fingerprint, and frame counts.
  4. Verification:
    • Rust unit tests passing (\cargo test -p sb-core).
    • Verified cancellation and resume flows.

issues.display_title: Issue #50: feat(ingest): project directory conflict detection and resolution modal
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Summary

Added conflict detection when ingesting into a non-empty or previously interrupted project directory, providing explicit resolution choices to the user.

Key Changes

  • Conflict Inspection: Implemented \inspect_ingest_conflict\ IPC command and backend analysis in \crates/sb-core/src/ingest/conflict.rs\ distinguishing \Clean, \Resumable, \ForeignDir, and \AlreadyCompleted.
  • Quarantine & Wipe: Added safe quarantine mechanism before replacing existing files.
  • Conflict Dialog UI: Built \IngestConflictModal.tsx\ prompting the user to Resume, Replace/Overwrite, or Cancel with translated strings.
  • Flow Integration: Wired pre-flight checks into \DropIngestFlow.tsx\ and \IngestPanel.tsx\ before triggering background jobs.

✅ Implementation & Verification Summary

Status: Completed & Ready for Review

Summary of Work Done:

  1. Directory Conflict Inspection:
    • Implemented \crates/sb-core/src/ingest/conflict.rs\ providing \inspect_ingest_conflict\ with statuses: \Clean, \Resumable, \ForeignDir, and \AlreadyCompleted.
    • Added IPC command \commands.inspectIngestConflict\ in \src-tauri/src/commands/ingest.rs.
  2. Conflict Resolution Modal:
    • Created \IngestConflictModal.tsx\ offering explicit options:
      • Resume: Continue frame extraction from the last valid frame.
      • Replace / Overwrite: Quarantines existing directory to .trash/_\ and starts fresh.
      • Cancel: Aborts ingest cleanly without touching existing files.
  3. Integration & Pre-flight Flow:

  • Continuous Route Geometry: Preserved full coordinate path in \effectiveRoute\ for smooth MapLibre blue line rendering without breaks or decimation.
  • Scrubbing & Navigation: Maintained active pin tracking and heading direction fallback during timeline scrubbing.
  • Unit Tests: Added test coverage in \src/features/map/tests/displayMarkers.test.ts.

issues.display_title: Issue #52: fix(gps): resolve blueline dot cutoff by parsing true telemetry timestamps
issues.main_description_html:
demo

Summary

Fixed an issue where pin markers on the map prematurely cut off along the blue route line (only covering ~10% of the route), leaving the remainder of the route markerless.

Cause

\load_track\ in \sb-core\ previously assumed 1 sample per second (\i as f64 - 1.0). For high-frequency GPS telemetry (e.g. 10 Hz with ~21,979 points over 2,198 seconds), the video duration limit was exhausted at index 2,198, stranding the remaining 90% of the physical track.

Key Changes

  • Timestamp Parsing: Updated \load_track\ in \crates/sb-core/src/gps/selection.rs\ to parse actual elapsed seconds from \point.time\ (both float seconds and RFC 3339 timestamps), with duration interpolation fallback.
  • Full Track Coverage: Frame selection now distributes 100% across the full path (from start to end) for all step sizes.
  • EXIF Geotagging Parity: Updated \crates/sb-core/src/upload/queue.rs\ to look up frame coordinates from the computed selection result rather than linear track array indexing.

✅ Implementation & Verification Summary

Status: Completed & Ready for Review

Summary of Work Done:

  1. Telemetry Timestamp Parsing:
    • Identified root cause where \load_track\ assumed 1 sample/sec (\second = i - 1.0), cutting off 10 Hz GPS telemetry prematurely at 10% of route length.
    • Implemented \parse_point_second\ in \crates/sb-core/src/gps/selection.rs\ to accurately parse elapsed seconds from point timestamps (\point.time, both float strings and RFC 3339 timestamps) with duration interpolation fallback.
  2. 100% Track Distribution:
    • Frame selection and display markers now cover the entire track from beginning to end across all step sizes (e.g. 1 frame, 25 frames, 50 frames) along the Chobe River test track.
  3. EXIF Metadata Geotagging Fix:
    • Updated \crates/sb-core/src/upload/queue.rs\ to derive frame coordinates from selection results rather than raw array indices.
  4. Verification:
    • \cargo test --workspace\ passed (134/134 tests).
    • Golden regression tests (\golden_insta360_*) and parity hardening tests passed 100%.

issues.display_title: Issue #53: fix(map): prevent UI freeze when switching selection mode from frames to gps
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

2026-10-07.13-59-08.mp4

Summary

Fixes a severe UI freeze and lag occurring when switching coordinate selection mode from Frames to GPS.

Root Cause

When switching mode from Frames to GPS in the UI, framesStore.setSelectionMode("gps") immediately updated the manifest selection mode to "gps", while commands.computeSelection ran asynchronously in the backend. During this in-flight window:

  1. MapCanvas re-rendered immediately with isLayersMode = false.
  2. selectionResult still held the previous raw track from layers mode (~21,979 markers).
  3. getDisplayMarkers bypassed the layer frame filter (if (!isLayersMode) return valid;), dumping all raw markers into MapLibre.
  4. MapLibre attempted to instantiate ~22,000 DOM elements and SVG markers synchronously on the main thread, freezing the WebView before the new GPS selection arrived.

Solution

  1. Selection Mode Synchronization: Included mode in SelectionResult (sb-core) and SelectionResultUi (Tauri IPC), updating MapCanvas to evaluate the active mode directly from the calculated selectionResult.
  2. Defensive Safety Guard: Added a safeguard in getDisplayMarkers to prevent dumping raw tracks (>500 points and >2x frames) to the DOM during mode transitions.
  3. Tests: Added unit tests in displayMarkers.test.ts and sb-core verifying safety filtering and mode serialization.

Completed Implementation Details

  1. Selection Mode Synchronization Across IPC:

    • Updated SelectionResult in crates/sb-core/src/gps/selection.rs and SelectionResultUi in src-tauri/src/commands/projects.rs to include the computed selection mode (pub mode: SelectionMode).
    • Updated SelectionResultUi interface in src/shared/api/commands.ts.
    • Updated src/features/map/components/MapCanvas.tsx to read isLayersMode from selectionResult?.mode (falling back to manifest?.selection.mode === "layers"). This guarantees that during the asynchronous recomputation window, the UI continues displaying pins consistent with the existing computed selection result instead of prematurely switching to GPS mode and treating thousands of raw polyline samples as interactive pins.

  2. Defensive Safety Guard in getDisplayMarkers:

    • Added an automatic guard in src/features/map/model/displayMarkers.ts: if !isLayersMode is triggered while the marker list still contains raw track coordinates (valid.length > frames.length * 2 && valid.length > 500), the function automatically prevents dumping thousands of raw points to MapLibre and filters to matching selected frames instead.

  3. Testing & Quality Verification:

    • Added displayMarkers.test.ts test verifying the safety guard suppresses dumping 600 raw track markers.
    • Added Rust unit test selection_result_preserves_mode in crates/sb-core/src/gps/selection.rs.
    • Verified with:
      • cargo test --lib (139 sb-core tests + 4 app_lib tests passed)
      • cargo clippy --workspace (clean, 0 warnings)
      • Subagent rust-reviewer verification (approved: zero-cost copy, wire-compatible, safe)
      • pnpm test (16 suites, 109 unit tests passed)
      • pnpm lint (clean)
      • pnpm build (TypeScript check & Vite production build passed)

issues.display_title: Issue #48: Fix Issue App Refresh every 30 seconds and upload button not working
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Desc

Sample: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CH3eKRhOudBaFw5N6_wsnwE6TrL_8cgc?usp=sharing

  • Fix Issue App Refresh every 30 seconds
  • Fix Issue Upload button not shown and not working
  • Fix Issue Uploaded panorama is not placed based on panorama location data

🚀 Progress Update: Upload Button & Progress Visibility Fix

Regarding: "Fix Issue Upload button not shown and not working"

❓ What was the problem?

  1. Upload button became disabled after returning to Viewer:
    • When an upload started and the user went back to the panorama Viewer, the button became grayed out and unclickable.
    • This locked users out, preventing them from returning to the Upload screen to monitor progress, pause, or resume the upload.
  2. No progress visibility while working in the Viewer:
    • Once back in the Viewer, there was no indication whether the upload was running, paused, or finished. Users had no feedback on what was happening in the background.
  3. Background progress updates appeared stuck:
    • Real-time progress updates (such as frame counts and GPS metadata tagging steps) were not consistently updating the UI.

💡 What was fixed?

  1. Always-accessible Upload navigation:
    • The button is no longer locked when a background process is active. Users can now freely switch between the Viewer and the Upload screen at any time.
  2. Live status button in the Viewer:
    • When an upload is running in the background, the button in the Viewer actively shows the current status (e.g., Uploading (45%) with an animated spinner, or Upload paused (45%)).
    • Clicking the button takes the user directly back to the Upload dashboard.
    • When inside the Upload dashboard, it functions as "Back to Viewer".
  3. TopBar Upload Progress Pill:
    • Added a compact upload pill in the top bar (similar to the video import indicator).
    • Displays the tour name and live percentage from any screen in the app. Clicking it jumps straight to the upload view.
  4. Reliable progress tracking:
    • Fixed background synchronization so progress percentage and status messages update smoothly and accurately without freezing.

✅ Verification

  • All automated unit tests pass (119/119 tests).
  • Frontend and backend builds verified with zero errors.
